passages.text: Northwind Ledger exports bookings to DATEV Unternehmen online through a DATEV-certified interface, so tax advisors receive postings without manual re-entry.
Northwind Ledger connects to SAP S/4HANA Cloud and S/4HANA on-premise through a certified connector that syncs journal entries, vendors and cost centers every 15 minutes.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is supported with a two-way connector for vendors, purchase orders and posted invoices.
NetSuite customers use the Northwind Ledger SuiteApp to sync subsidiaries, intercompany journals and exchange rates.
Every object in Northwind Ledger is available through a REST API with OAuth 2.0 and webhooks, documented at the developer portal.
Northwind Ledger holds an ISO 27001 certificate and a SOC 2 Type II report, both renewed every year and available under NDA.
Single sign-on works with any SAML 2.0 identity provider, including Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, and user provisioning is available through SCIM.
Customer data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest with AES-256.
Customer data is hosted in AWS eu-central-1 in Frankfurt with backups in AWS eu-west-1 in Dublin, so data stays in the European Union.
A data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR is part of every contract, and the current list of subprocessors is published on the trust page.
Northwind Ledger does not use customer data to train AI models, and AI features can be switched off per entity.
AI invoice coding suggests the general ledger account and cost center for each incoming invoice, and a person approves every suggestion before posting.
Northwind Ledger sends and receives XRechnung and ZUGFeRD invoices and connects to the Peppol network for cross-border e-invoicing.
Northwind Ledger supports the German B2B e-invoicing obligation that started on 1 January 2025, including receipt of structured invoices.
Multi-entity consolidation runs intercompany eliminations and currency translation, and most customers close the month in five working days.
The audit trail records every change with user and time stamp and follows the GoBD requirements for German bookkeeping.
Bank statements are imported through EBICS for German, Austrian and Swiss banks and through PSD2 connections for most other European banks.
Implementation takes 6 to 10 weeks for most customers, led by a named onboarding manager and a certified partner where needed.
The product is available in German, English and French, and support answers in German and English.
Support is available on working days from 8:00 to 18:00 CET by chat, email and phone, with a 4-hour first response target.
Pricing depends on the number of entities and invoice volume, and our team shares a written quote after a short call.
We do not offer a self-service trial; instead we run a guided pilot with your own data for qualified companies.
Northwind Ledger is built for companies with 200 or more employees and several legal entities.
